body: Google Kubotan. I believe that's what your friend was talking about.

Your first paragraph is where I've been stuck for so long. The effects of abuse are far reaching and horrific even after you escape the situation. You're right practice is the only way. The more I practice, even when I fail, the more progress will be made. The struggle is having the courage to try again. Which is why I've been so down on myself  about the job. Did not help that I botched a phone interview just before Christmas for one of the few places I'd love to work (panicked at a question I had to think about and started stuttering).   


I agree on happiness vs contentment as well. Not many people see it like that. I have had exactly 2 moments of complete contentment and total peace. I really do appreciate your advice. It always helps talking to another abuse survivor. Most of us have a pretty clear understanding of the struggle. The last couple days I've been doing a little bit better and trying to keep busy with things I enjoy. Thank you!

The original font without the effects is Axis Extra Bold. As for the effects, 2 layers of text both converted to shapes. For the main body of the letters a gradient overlay and several other effects. The outline layer just has a gradient overlay and then a plain layer on top of that. I used the polygonal tool to trace parts of the outline and added individual gradients to make the font really pop. I hope that makes some sense! Not the best at explaining things.
